summary: For the last 10 minutes of the authorized window (2026-10-06T10:33:47Z-10:43:47Z) checkout shows real failures, but they are localized to one dependency hop and are not elevated relative to the immediately preceding windows. Checkout's error spans are concentrated on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, and the sampled traces show payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge failing with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (grpc status 2 at payment, propagated as status 13 / HTTP 500 up to frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator). Checkout's other dependency calls (cart GetCart/EmptyCart, currency Convert, product-catalog GetProduct, shipping GetQuote/ShipOrder) returned grpc status 0 in the same window. Measured latencies are low in absolute terms (single-digit to low-teens milliseconds per client call; failing PlaceOrder spans 31.5-41.5 ms), and the only like-for-like latency series available shows a rise in GetCart average latency that coincides with a period when GetCart was fast-failing with grpc status 14, so it is not a like-for-like degradation baseline. The 'elevated errors' framing is not supported against the recent past: checkout ERROR-span increases per 10-minute lookback were 23.0-33.3 for windows ending 10:25:47-10:31:47 versus 8.25 for the window ending 10:43:47. Email was not observed at all and no complete latency baseline exists, so the answer is partial.

claims.text: In the last 10 minutes (2026-10-06T10:33:47Z-10:43:47Z) the checkout service's ERROR-status span series (increase over a 10-minute range selector) is 8.251768764739705, alongside a checkout UNSET-status series of 171.73022860464295; the counter counts spans of every checkout operation, internal, client and server alike, so neither value is a request count.

Broken down by span name in the same window, checkout's ERROR spans sit on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (4.125884382369852) and on checkout's own client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (4.125884382369852); checkout's other returned span-name rows carry 0 for the ERROR status (e.g. oteldemo.CartService/GetCart = 0).

Checkout's outbound gRPC client histogram in the last 10 minutes localizes the failure to payment: rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count increase is 9.206286757123305 with rpc_grpc_status_code 0 and 3.2062470314726395 with rpc_grpc_status_code 2 for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, while every other returned checkout dependency series carries rpc_grpc_status_code 0 (CartService/GetCart 12.658644291044544, CartService/EmptyCart 9.206286757123305, CurrencyService/Convert 33.37278949457198, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 20.714145203527437, ShippingService/GetQuote 12.658644291044544, ShippingService/ShipOrder 9.206286757123305).

The payment service itself contributes ERROR spans in the last 10 minutes (9.542875123110592) on span names grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (4.125884382369852), GET (2.166796296296296), dns.lookup (1.083398148148148) and tcp.connect (2.166796296296296); the payment transaction counter increase for the same window is 7.95476709679032.

The cart service contributes ERROR spans in the last 10 minutes (3.2501944444444444) on span names POST (1.083398148148148) and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (2.166796296296296), i.e. not on cart's GetCart handler.

Two sampled checkout traces fail in the same way: trace 06c5286b0019a39fbf755fc785bde0dd and trace a60c724ffd4dcfff13752c788040a36c each contain a checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span (span_ids 2be3e9aecd382f18 and a9b5f3e5f4707921) with otel.status_code ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', plus a failing downstream grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span handled by the payment service (span_ids 744939bbc6af9fc5 and 7190b6375a34d3f0) with error=true and message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'.

The visible parent references in those traces describe the path load-generator POST -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' -> frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' -> frontend 'POST /api/checkout' -> frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' -> checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' -> checkout 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' -> payment 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge', with HTTP 500 recorded at the load-generator, frontend-proxy and frontend layers; this is a sampled view, not the complete trace graph.

The failing and dependency spans in the sample are short: checkout PlaceOrder spans 41513 us and 31511 us, checkout-side PaymentService/Charge client spans 17067 us and 10442 us, payment-side Charge spans 8087 us and 2576 us, shipping GetQuote 7210-12311 us, currency Convert 245-1087 us, product-catalog GetProduct 28-121 us and cart GetCart 285-3607 us.

Averaged checkout client-call latency (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_sum divided by count, computed by the query itself) over the returned points spanning 10:22:47Z-10:43:47Z is low: in the latest point Charge 10.003833567577386 ms, Convert 3.120087310344827 ms, EmptyCart 13.934534249999997 ms, GetCart 3.7217480909090908 ms, GetProduct 0.9054083888888889 ms, GetQuote 11.315935727272727 ms, ShipOrder 0.4844172499999999 ms; across the four latest points Charge falls (15.111414999999994 -> 12.185032869578682 -> 9.776524304344655 -> 10.003833567577386) while GetCart rises (0.6169954999999999 -> 0.9174783634261674 -> 3.1446485254019327 -> 3.7988333314206075 -> 3.7217480909090908).

In the earlier 10-minute window 2026-10-06T10:13:47Z-10:23:47Z checkout shows 20.00302222222222 ERROR-status spans while the service's all-status span series for the same window is 30.00453333333333, and in the window 2026-10-06T10:23:47Z-10:33:47Z checkout shows 20 ERROR-status spans (payment 5.469115560657418 in that later window).

In the 10:13:47Z-10:23:47Z window checkout's GetCart client calls were failing with rpc_grpc_status_code 14 (UNAVAILABLE) at an increase of 8.474540959471097, and no Charge/Convert/GetProduct/GetQuote client series were returned for that window (a non-returned series is unknown, not zero).

The ERROR-status breakdown by service and span name for the last 10 minutes returned rows for ad (0), cart, checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator, payment and recommendation only; no ERROR-status row was returned for product-catalog, currency, shipping, quote or email, and the separate all-status breakdown likewise returned no error series for product-catalog, currency, shipping, quote or email. Because a series that is not returned is unknown rather than zero, this does not prove those services had no errors.

The rise in checkout->CartService/GetCart average latency (0.19153900000000001 ms in the earliest returned point to 3.7217480909090908 ms in the latest) does not demonstrate degraded responsiveness: the low early values coincide with GetCart calls failing fast with rpc_grpc_status_code 14 (UNAVAILABLE) in the 10:13:47Z-10:23:47Z window, and all later values remain below 4 ms.

The report of currently elevated checkout errors is contradicted by the comparable recent baseline: checkout ERROR-span increases per 10-minute lookback were 23.002266666666667, 30.627047139681544 and 33.33339506184271 for the points ending 10:25:47Z, 10:28:47Z and 10:31:47Z, 20.0 for the discrete window 10:23:47Z-10:33:47Z, and only 8.251768764739705 for the last 10 minutes, with one intervening point at 0; frontend and frontend-proxy error counts fell by roughly one to two orders of magnitude over the same span, and a discrete 10:13:47Z-10:23:47Z window shows checkout at 20.00302222222222 error spans against 30.00453333333333 all-status spans.

Rejected: that the whole dependency set listed in the report (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) is failing or slow for checkout in the last 10 minutes. In that window only payment shows a failing hop (rpc_grpc_status_code 2 on checkout's Charge client calls), while checkout's client calls to product-catalog, currency, cart and shipping all carry rpc_grpc_status_code 0, and the sampled spans for those dependencies carry status 0 or no status tag with sub-13 ms durations; email was not observed at all in the sample, so its behaviour remains unknown rather than confirmed.

Advisory for human follow-up: inspect the payment charge rejection path and any fault-injection or feature-flag configuration that produces 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', since the observed checkout failures all terminate at that payment response and propagate as gRPC status 13 / HTTP 500 to the browser-facing layers.

gaps: No comparable pre-window latency baseline: the 10-minute windows 2026-10-06T10:03:47Z-10:13:47Z and 09:33:47Z-09:43:47Z returned no data for error-span counts (evidence_ids 38d752c3-9735-4a6f-a1be-e40c97797d4f-t1:d9619fff-3f66-4390-8f21-408d817d29a6 and 73295f9a-59c5-46f6-ba4c-93ce416cc245-t1:57ada78c-6f84-4e10-867f-c4a5194689c9) and for rpc client counts (73295f9a-59c5-46f6-ba4c-93ce416cc245-t3:dddb158d-421f-4caf-877a-ea84eef11980), and the 10:13:47Z-10:23:47Z window returned rpc client series for only two methods, so a like-for-like latency baseline for checkout's dependency calls is unavailable and latency trend claims must stay limited to the returned points.

Email: no email span appeared in the two sampled checkout traces and the email trace search for 2026-10-06T10:41:47Z-10:43:47Z returned no traces (status no_data, evidence_id 38d752c3-9735-4a6f-a1be-e40c97797d4f-t3:61b82686-6fcd-4dd6-a7f7-0e2c533f620f), so whether checkout invoked email in the last 10 minutes, and whether it failed, is unknown.

The checkout trace search over the full 10-minute window was refused as RESULT_TOO_LARGE (123520 tokens, operation_id ff57a30c-2be5-4702-88b2-d6423504b679-t2, no evidence_id returned), so the visible traces cover only 10:41:47Z-10:42:40Z (limit 5, 2 traces, 70 spans) and cannot establish failure rates or a complete call graph.

http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned series only for cart and flagd in the last 10 minutes (evidence_id 73295f9a-59c5-46f6-ba4c-93ce416cc245-t2:5ea16609-ee55-49cb-807a-0306c0bae93c), so HTTP-level latency for checkout and frontend is unknown from that metric; label coverage is incomplete.

ERROR-status series were not returned for product-catalog, currency, shipping, quote or email in the last 10 minutes; those series remain unknown rather than zero, and the query could not show whether such spans existed for those services.

The metric values for the same series are fractional (e.g. Charge status-2 count 3.2062470314726395), and no documentation of the counter's scaling is available in the delivered context, so absolute call volumes derived from them are approximations.
No trace search was run for payment, cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog or quote as standalone services, so services' own self-reported failures outside the checkout path are unknown.
Whether the payment 'Invalid token' rejection is an intentional fault injection, a configuration change or a genuine defect cannot be determined from the delivered evidence.
